victim.name: Maya Rao
victim.note: Single mother; murdered inside the family home. Her infant daughter is found alive.

suspects.name: Arjun Rao
suspects.note: Officially blamed early in the investigation. Physical evidence against him is weak and becomes increasingly questionable.

suspects.name: Daniel Mehta
suspects.note: Had access to Maya and potential motive. His timeline contains contradictions that become important later.

suspects.name: Vikram Sethi
suspects.note: Had access to evidence and case records. Possible corruption, protection, investigative failure, or participation in the cover-up must be considered.

timeline.event: Maya is found dead inside the family home, concealed under a bed; her infant daughter is found alive
Initial scene evidence appears to implicate Arjun
The official investigation develops around Arjun as the primary suspect
Scene documentation is found not to perfectly agree with later-recovered information
Chain-of-custody records are found to contain gaps; a case-connected weapon is discovered missing
A storage-unit recovery produces evidence not properly reflected in the original investigation
Forensic reconstruction suggests the official version of the scene is incomplete

evidence.name: Original Scene Photographs
evidence.description: Establishes the initial physical scene. True but incomplete.

evidence.name: Initial Police Scene Report
evidence.description: Compromised — contains information that conflicts with later material.

evidence.name: Evidence Transfer Discrepancy
evidence.description: Links a missing item to a break in the evidence chain.

evidence.name: Missing Weapon Record
evidence.description: Shows that an expected evidence item is absent from the trail.

evidence.name: Projectile / Trajectory Analysis
evidence.description: Challenges the single-attacker interpretation; suggests multiple positions and potentially multiple contributors to the scene.

evidence.name: Recovered Forensic Material
evidence.description: Provides evidence not represented correctly in the original case.

evidence.name: Storage-Unit Evidence
evidence.description: Introduces an independent evidence trail outside the original case record.

evidence.name: Arjun-Related Physical Evidence
evidence.description: Weak / questionable — creates the original suspect narrative but weakens on provenance review.

evidence.name: Second Scene-Photo Set
evidence.description: Reveals contradictions with the official record.

evidence.name: Daniel's Timeline
evidence.description: Partially reliable — contains contradictions requiring verification.

evidence.name: Investigation Notes
evidence.description: Compromised / incomplete — shows how the original narrative developed.

evidence.name: Final Reconstructed Scene
evidence.description: Allows the player to separate murder evidence from investigation manipulation.

puzzles.name: Crime Scene Reconstruction & Chain of Custody
puzzles.description: Compare scene photographs, reports, and physical descriptions to identify contradictions, then reconstruct who handled each evidence item and locate unexplained gaps.

puzzles.name: Missing Weapon & Trajectory Reconstruction
puzzles.description: Determine when the weapon disappeared from the evidence trail and who had access, then use projectile paths and positions to test whether one attacker could explain the scene.

puzzles.name: Storage Unit & Arjun Evidence Audit
puzzles.description: Investigate recovered material and determine whether it contradicts the official case narrative, then test every item used against Arjun for provenance, reliability, and alternative explanations.

puzzles.name: Daniel Timeline & Investigator Access
puzzles.description: Compare Daniel's stated movements with independent records, then map Vikram's access to evidence and case records without automatically equating access with guilt.

puzzles.name: Final Reconstruction
puzzles.description: Separate what happened during the murder from what happened during the investigation. A strong solution reconstructs the murder, identifies compromised evidence, explains the investigation's failures or manipulation, and distinguishes what is proven from what remains uncertain.
puzzles.ai_initial_behavior: Initially steers the player toward Arjun because that is the official narrative; if the player starts auditing evidence sources, the AI becomes less cooperative and presents more ambiguous framing.
puzzles.design_constraint: The murderer and the cover-up participant do not have to be the same person. The AI should never randomly change the underlying truth of evidence — adaptation controls access, timing, framing, and hints only.

hypotheses.statement: Arjun killed Maya and the original investigation is substantially correct.
Daniel killed Maya and the investigation incorrectly focused on Arjun.
Multiple attackers were involved in the original crime.
The murder and the later evidence manipulation were carried out by different people.
Vikram Sethi was directly involved in the murder rather than merely the investigation.
The physical evidence was altered enough that some original conclusions can no longer be treated as reliable.
